meaning.en: (anatomy) Of or pertaining to both fibrous and muscular tissue.

sentences.en: Fibromuscular dysplasia is a congenital disorder involving thickening of the arterial wall and is a cause of renal artery stenosis in younger adults, particularly women 20 to 40 years old.
